findings.summary: crates/server/src/sources.rs: the first failed read is thrown away before the retry, so an intermittent failure is never logged.

crates/server/src/linear.rs: the query reads closed tickets too and stops at MAX_PAGES without saying so. The query now asks only for open tickets; past 1000 open tickets per project the rest are still dropped without a warning.
board.toml: lists two repos where the ticket asks for one.
crates/app/src/main.rs: card() draws only one level of sub-tickets.
